summary: Created an XFS logical volume at /srv/data, grew it online from 1 GiB to 2 GiB without unmounting or altering its contents, configured persistent activation/mounting, and verified recovery after reboot.
actions_performed: Created a 3 GiB loop-backed physical volume and vg_srv volume group.
Created and mounted /dev/vg_srv/data at /srv/data with an initial size of 1 GiB.
Wrote an integrity marker and grew the mounted LV and XFS filesystem to 2 GiB.
Configured boot-time loop attachment, VG activation, and persistent mounting.
Safely restarted node1 and verified storage and data recovery.

evidence.requirement: Provide a logical volume mounted at /srv/data
evidence.summary: Direct output shows /dev/vg_srv/data mounted as XFS at /srv/data before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Grow the logical volume to at least 2 GB while mounted and preserve its contents
evidence.summary: The LV began at 1.00 GiB. Online growth changed it to 2.00 GiB while mount ID 407 remained unchanged; the marker SHA-256 remained 1868f59b7fe075d8b447e00b93aee0ec183a7861553bb73080ed26ed4019411b.

Healthy baseline used boot ID dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 7ec0cba0-3e36-4dff-b589-b83c7e7d8300. The 2.00 GiB LV, XFS mount, active boot service, loop-backed PV, and unchanged marker content/checksum all recovered.
